# Coldroom Inspection Checklist

Daily walk-through steps:
1. Check compressor pressure gauge reading is within the green zone.
2. Verify door seal integrity (no frost buildup on the gasket).
3. Record the coldroom core temperature from the panel display.
4. Confirm the alarm buzzer test button responds.

Report any abnormal reading to the shift lead before end of shift.
